title: Loyalty free meal reward
description: Tell diners they earned a free meal or dessert in your loyalty program. Loyalty reward WhatsApp template for restaurants.
notes: State how to redeem and when it expires. Rewards messages do best right after a visit.

body.text: You did it, {{first_name}}! After {{points}} points at {{restaurant}} you've earned a free {{item}}. Show this message to your server by {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
